entries.rawContent:
Quick research dump on competitor pricing pages:
- Linear: 3 tiers, annual toggle, FAQ collapsed
- Vercel: 3 tiers, calculator widget, prominent enterprise CTA
- Stripe: 2 tiers + custom, pay-as-you-go emphasis
Common thread: 3-tier card grid + clear annual savings.
Great summary. Let's do: 3-tier card layout, annual toggle with 20% savings copy, FAQ at the bottom, enterprise CTA in nav. Engineer can start this week.
Yes — and make sure mobile collapses to a horizontal scroller for the cards.

expected.rubric: Should return 'propose-scope'. The team has done the research, picked a concrete pattern (3-tier cards, annual toggle, FAQ, enterprise CTA), and named the mobile constraint. A scope_proposal with 2–4 tasks (e.g. cards, toggle, FAQ, mobile layout) is appropriate.
